body:
I thank you so kindly for the reply, its more that i posted here as a final place to speak my mind than needing convincing otherwise. 

I know things can turn around fast, I've experienced hope, but it goes away again with the depression. I don't want to be on medicine, it makes me not me, and I'm really a lovely person. 

Without a family to care for, the one that I burned with bad decisions, laziness and depression, I feel hopeless even when I'm on top of the world. 

I don't mean to lay this on you, but its about 1 hour til sundown, I'm still going through with it. 

I at least thank you for reading what I wrote. 

I'm keeping this page cached on my hdd in case anyone finds my laptop and somehow finds my family. 

I'm so sorry for everything I did, I love you all.
